structured.answer: Basically everything outside plain index funds and pension tracks is "לא מחושב": ETCs, gold funds, corporate bonds, Israel Bonds, FX deposits/dollar-linked deposits, money-market dollar funds, structured products, REITs, digital portfolios, ביטוח מנהלים, participating life policies, annuity commutation, and even the FX conversion fee. On top of that, stock picking, trading, derivatives, loans, non-savings insurance and past-return rankings are permanently out of scope, so for my single-stock and FX setup it can't help.
